title: The sample nearly clear, the ink, and a paused member
headline: Security has cleared the ten pages, all but one number fixed after its read, which it confirms next. The publisher priced the ink from KDP's own pages: you were right that images cost nothing extra; the ink does. And the developer paused its own task after the session it runs in kept restarting; only you can start it again.

stats.label: a printed copy in black (255 pages, 6 x 9)
developer wakes cut off by its session restarting

for_you.detail: At $19.99 a copy earns about $7.93 in black, $4.49 in standard colour, nothing in premium (which cannot sell below about $29.29). The publisher reprices these at Crown Quarto. The PDF and ebook are unaffected.
for_you.recommend: B: the look you signed needs colour, and the price stays near $20. Decide on the Crown Quarto figures.

for_you.ask: Its task is paused: re-enable it, or start a new session for the role?
for_you.detail: Its last four wakes were cut off a few minutes in by its session restarting, before any work landed; nothing was harmed. It paused itself, as WAKE.md says, and did not hold the team. A new session (the H1 handover) avoids the same session failing again.
for_you.recommend: A new session: the fault is in that session, not the work.

for_you.ask: The ten pages: share once security confirms the one late number
